scripts.build:app: npm run build --workspace @parautos/shared && npm run build --workspace @parautos/server && npm run build --workspace @parautos/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @parautos/server" "npm run dev --workspace @parautos/client"
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @parautos/shared && npm run test --workspace @parautos/server && npm run test --workspace @parautos/client
